notes.title: New Moon Map and Arctic Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45109627/60b8cf0d51c168b9a7dea50ff6f20a36255734ce.png[/img]
We are excited to present our new update for the drone simulator:

[list]
[*] [h3]New Moon Map Added[/h3]
Now you can explore the surface of the Moon with its unique landscape and low gravity. Enjoy a new flying experience in this captivating location.

[*] [h3]Arctic Map Optimization[/h3]
The Arctic map has been thoroughly optimized to improve performance. Your flights in this harsh but beautiful region will now be even smoother.

[*] [h3]Italian Localization Fixed[/h3]
We have improved the Italian localization to make your experience more comfortable and accurate.
[/list]

notes.title: New Update: Localization and Enhanced Language Settings!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Players![/h2]

We continue to improve your gaming experience and are excited to present our new update, which brings significant improvements in localization and language settings.

[h3]New Localization:[/h3]
We have added support for the following languages:

[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] Italian
[*] Korean
[*] Japanese
[*] Turkish
[*] Russian
[*] Ukrainian
[*] German
[*] French
[/list]
Now you can enjoy the game in your native language or any other language you prefer. We aim to make our project accessible to as many players as possible worldwide.

[h3]Enhanced Language Settings:[/h3]
In this update, we have also expanded the language settings:

[list]
[*] Language Change in Settings: You can easily change the game language through the settings menu.
[*] Steam Language Settings Integration: The game now automatically synchronizes with the language settings of your Steam application. This means the game will launch in the language set in your Steam preferences.
[/list]
These changes are designed to make the language change process more intuitive and convenient, so you can easily select the desired options and focus on the gameplay.

We appreciate your continuous attention and support. Your feedback and suggestions play a crucial role in our efforts to improve the game. Please share your thoughts and ideas - we are always happy to hear from you!
